description: Custom, mobile-friendly websites that explain your services, showcase your work and give visitors a clear way to contact you. Each project begins with an agreed scope, quote and timeline.

Refresh or rebuild an existing website with clearer service information, mobile-friendly pages and easier contact options. We review the current site and agree on priorities, scope and timing before work begins.
Websites for small businesses in Windsor-Essex and across Canada. Present your services, business details and examples of your work, with mobile-friendly pages and a clear contact form.
Website layouts designed to work across phones, tablets and computers. We check navigation, text, images and contact forms so visitors can find information and reach your business from their device.
Help connecting your domain, configuring website hosting and setting up a secure HTTPS connection. We explain the setup and any ongoing provider costs before you commit.

SEO essentials including page titles, descriptions, clear page structure and relevant content, so search engines can better understand your website. Local business details and Google Business Profile guidance are available.
Ongoing website support with small content updates, website checks and performance reviews. We agree on the care plan, included work and ongoing costs based on the support your website needs.

Focused, mobile-friendly pages for a specific service, offer or campaign. Clear messaging and a relevant inquiry form give visitors a simple next step. Scope and goals are agreed before design begins.
